comment.narrative: GENERAL DISCLAIMER valid for all Results and Indicators.On 23rd December 2023 EU Delegation to Azerbaijan EUD received a Note Verbale from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Azerbaijan communicated the decision of the Government of Azerbaijan to suspendstop the implementation of the all European Union funded twinning projects in the country hereinafter called also as the BC decision without providing additional reasons for this decision including Twinning Project Increasing Road Safety in Azerbaijan. To clarify BC position concerning the project in particular the implementation of the project related activities organisation of short term experts missions as well as the organisation of the project Steering Committee Meetings note verbale from EUD has been sent to Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Azerbaijan on 9th April 2024. However there has been no response from the BC.In June 2024 as reply to the mail sent by RTA to BC PL of BC shared via call phone the final decision of the Azerbaijani administration of refusing restart of the project implementation.On 1st July 2024 twinning team has received the EUD decision of the termination of the twinning contract by giving three months notice from the date of this letter. It meant that the project should end on 30th of September 2024. This decision was taken in accordance to the Article 5.10.2 of the Twinning Manual to the provisions of Article 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 of the Special Conditions and of Article 12 of the General Conditions of the Twinning Grant Contract.The first 1 of 7 mission of the Activity 1.1.2. has been conducted online on 1619.01.2024.Due to circumstances faced by the twinning project since end of December 2023 the mission was carried out online as planned in the Work Plan without active participation of representatives from the Beneficiary Country.The objective of the mission was to review and enhance the vehicle maintenance system. It involved the preparation of legislation related to the vehicle maintenance. Shortterm experts from Lithuania based on past results and key indicators identified specific areas for intervention aligned with road safety objectives.The Mission Report has been prepared together with The list of possible correction measures and forwarded to BC for review and feedback. STEs didnt received any comments. Nevertheless BC replied that it would be taken into account in the legislative process in Azerbaijan.Due to the BC Decision STEs couldnt conduct other 6 missions foreseen within this Activity and continue also online consultation process about recommendations and deliver other products. The BC decision caused delay of the Activity at the end of the project by 1 month. STEs and RTA team were ready to conduct all plan activities and missions. Therefore ACTIVITY 1.1.2. WAS NOT FULLY COMPLETED.
